name: @syneva/dashboard
description: The Syneva dashboard: a Cloudflare Worker that answers its API and serves a React app listing the reviews by project and showing each review's code. It authenticates with Better Auth and reads GitHub App repositories and pull requests.

scripts.check: pnpm types && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.dev.jsonc
scripts.type-check: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json
